hero.filename: Derryquin Castle c.1870. Pen & ink sketch by William Herbert Stokes (1845-1874).JPG
hero.caption: The artist's mother, Letitia Bland, was born in Derryquin Castle.  Letitia married Henry Stokes, County Surveyor of Kerry, and the Stokes family lived at Askive, close to Derryquin.  William Stokes, a Civil Engineer like his father, emigrated to Chicago in 1872 but died soon after. This sketch has been kept in the family; it is now owned by his great-great niece, Charlotte Verity, who is married to Christopher Le Brun, President of the Royal Academy.
